title: When He Touched My Mouth
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler of tender words, and tonight Jeremiah, who had no words of his own, is given the Lord's words, just as Willow is given kind words for a crying friend.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because tender words are a gift we are given, not something we must make alone. In Willow's world today: a friend at the sand table was crying, and Willow had no idea what to say. She sat down close and stayed. Then the words came: 'You can build with me.' Just like Jeremiah, whose words were placed in his mouth, Willow learned that Heavenly Father sends kind words right when they are needed.
